lines: Sometimes, you're not holding on to the person.
You're holding on to the person you hope they will become.
You keep forgiving the same behavior because they promise to change.
You remember their best moments and ignore the pattern.
But a promise is not progress.
People can change, but real change shows in their actions, not just their words.
Stop asking yourself, "Who could they become?"
Ask yourself, "If nothing changed, would I still choose this person?"
Love someone for who they are today, not just for who you hope they will be tomorrow.
Follow for more psychology and life lessons that can change the way you see life.
